info.title: GATEWAY-batchinsertion-List Logistics Shipments Labels-v4-spec
info.description: The Logistics Shipments Label Retrieval API allows businesses to access and list shipment labels for logistics operations. This endpoint provides detailed information about shipping labels associated with logistics shipments, which can be beneficial for tracking and managing shipments effectively. Typical consumers include logistics managers, shipping coordinators, and inventory systems that integrate label management. By utilizing this API, users can streamline their shipping processes and enhance operational visibility.

get.description: This endpoint allows you to fetch the shipping label for a specific shipment. You can use this label for tracking and postal purposes.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to retrieve shipment labels. It contains the necessary parameters required for the operation, structured as a JSON object.
